# JobQueueOptions.logger property

Logger for the queue's own log and error messages.

**Signature:**

```typescript
logger?: ILogger;
```

## Default Value

console

## Remarks

Worth supplying, because this is the only channel through which some failures surface at all: [JobQueuePublisher.push()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueuepublisher.push/) reports a failed enqueue here and nowhere else. Pass a no-op logger to silence the queue.
